requirements: R52: Hub-owned OAuth, one organization and at most one Feishu app per Hub
R53: all saved identities contribute concurrently under owner-selected provider types

steps.name: Two independent browser accounts sign in
Owner creates a hub and downloads pairing; real Computer CLI attaches and connects outbound
Agent creation and live conversation traverse the outbound computer connection
Computer shutdown preserves the browser draft and reports offline
Computer restart restores persisted agent history and sending
Hub membership alone does not expose computer agents
Separate hub and computer invitations enable member creation and sending
Removing computer membership immediately makes an open agent read-only
Explicit hub retain policy overrides the computer read-only rule
Retained rights exclude new agents and never grant creation
Hub none policy removes retained access
Two computers attach independently to one hub and route to distinct runtimes
Mobile computer drawer opens and closes; viewport has no horizontal overflow

checks: Mobile provider registration preserves OAuth continuation and stores a nonextractable private key only on the client; registration grants no access
Reload retains the signing key and expired transport credentials recover by signing a real Hub challenge
A temporary 503 key challenge outage retains saved credentials and signing keys; retry recovers without signing in again
Owner invitations grant the registered viewer its Computer and read-only agent; operator placement is unavailable
Adding Google keeps the existing Feishu identity connected; the same Hub agent remains visible without duplicate entries
All saved identities contribute their available rights while each request uses one proof; shared Computer and agent entries are deduplicated
Fresh OAuth reauthentication rotates only the same identity's device key, preserves the other account, and does not accumulate active keys
Revoking a client key prevents that saved account from reconnecting
Revoking one identity leaves the other independently authorized identity connected and preserves its Computer access
The owner configures Google-only or both; a blocked saved Feishu key is retained and resumes automatically when allowed again
Fresh Google registration preserves pending setup continuation; one-time owner proof claims the Hub and pre-provisioned Computer before device key enrollment
registration.provider: Controlled Google/Feishu identity fixture; live provider credentials are not used

steps: Fixture authenticated session, PKCE hub cookie exchange, single-use enrollment and relayed conversation
One account uses two independently running hubs without sharing agent state
Returning to a hub restores only its own unsent draft
Second account sees only its invited hub and no ungranted computers
Optional authority sign-in has no password/code fallback and reports missing provider configuration
No uncaught browser errors in the separate-service flow

checks: An already-controlled tab upgrades the old worker before rendering; Hubs & computers loads working controls instead of the static-client error
Configured provider, model and reasoning are selected as real values, with disabled placeholders and no generic default option
Independent client opens Pi/Codex/Claude creation; provider-specific Pi models and reasoning reach the service worker launch request
Codex maps ChatGPT authentication and Fast correctly; changing models removes unsupported reasoning
Claude Code supports custom model and reasoning without inheriting another runtime's provider or Fast setting
pi: private endpoint, masked key, custom model and advanced controls reach the launch; switching providers clears credentials
codex: private endpoint, masked key, custom model and advanced controls reach the launch; switching providers clears credentials
cc: private endpoint, masked key, custom model and advanced controls reach the launch; switching providers clears credentials
Unknown configured provider or model stays unselected and cannot create an agent with empty launch values
Switching computers clears previous selections and paths; late catalog responses cannot replace current choices
Keyboard focus wraps within creation; Escape preserves dialog; invalid names focus their associated alert; pending launch announces status and locks choices
Account/workspace form submits the actual configured provider, model and reasoning; all three runtime forms fit 390px and cancel restores focus
Resume selects a scoped saved session or explicit ID, clears IDs on runtime changes, and sends no saved credentials
Owner creates Google and tenant-specific Feishu invitations using the actual mobile Manage access form
No provider account gains access before accepting an invitation; malformed codes display an error
An unrelated Google identity cannot redeem a Feishu invitation
Google and Feishu users accept through the actual invitation screen with verified provider identities
Reusing a redeemed code displays an error without another membership change
Two browser accounts verify single-agent viewer/operator sharing and revocation without computer membership, private-agent visibility or creation rights
Actual hub Sign-in methods copies the exact connection, identity and tenant for an invitation
Public HTTPS Hub advertises its sole configured Feishu app
Mobile browser displays Hub-owned provider login
Provider handoff uses Hub callback and PKCE without exposing secret
providerHandoff.providerLogin: Not performed: intercepted at provider handoff; actual user authorization still required

notes: Work Hub and separate auth preview use the reviewed release. Existing Home Hub, main frontend and Computer processes remain on their prior release to preserve session access.
Team Feishu app configured privately; real user authorization and provider console callback confirmation remain external acceptance. Home Google application credentials have not been supplied.
Controlled Google/Feishu fixtures validate concurrent access and owner policy through the real browser interface; they do not establish real-provider acceptance.

checks: Public separate frontend loads at390px without uncaught errors
Hubs & computers advertises configured Work Hub
Public configuration contains Hub origin without provider app secrets
